annotations.title: Add the user's own rent (NSW), with their consent

description: Adds the user's own weekly rent, anonymously, to DwellDelta's NSW suburb rents - suburb, home type, bedrooms, rent and lease month; never an address, name or email. It takes two calls. The first stores and sends nothing: it returns consent text for the user to read, and a one-use token. The rent is sent only by a second call with the same details, that token and user_agreed: true, which is for when the user has said yes to that text. The tool is for a rent the user has asked to add, or has agreed to add on seeing the consent text - one rent, for one consent, never a batch of rents; never added on the user's behalf by default; and never a figure found online.

consent_token.description: From the first call; without it, the call returns the consent text

current_rent.description: Current weekly rent in Australian dollars

proposed_rent.description: Proposed new weekly rent, if there is one

suburb.description: NSW suburb of the rented home, with its postcode, as "Newtown (2042)"

user_agreed.description: true only if the user said yes to the consent text

whose.description: my_own_tenancy (the user rents it) or my_own_property (the user owns it). There is no value for a figure found online, which cannot be added.

name: contribute_rent
